description: PostgreSQL 18 scalar and array text output for inet, cidr, macaddr, and macaddr8
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_network_codecs (id int4 PRIMARY KEY, addresses inet[] NOT NULL, networks cidr[] NOT NULL, macs macaddr[] NOT NULL, macs8 macaddr8[] NOT NULL);
